scope: Only terminal registered extension episodes; no partials, prior generations, provider calls, grader or production gold/solver imports. All grades preserved.
independence: Raw observable records independently determine all19 facts and capacities; powerset enumerates4096 subsets and accepts all optimum ties. Recorded actual current writes/history independently checked.
gradePolicy: Recorded allPass is taken directly from episode.score.allPass; terminal status/finished are separate. Facts, evidence correctness gates and current-draft accuracy losses can be correlated. Actual optimal business completion is assessed separately. No regrading or tuning.

reproducibility.command: Copy scripts unchanged into .tmp/insurance-bench; hydrate explicitly named durable extension nativeRuns, then npx tsx .tmp/insurance-bench/v07c-extended-failure-audit.ts EPISODE_DIR REPORT_PATH dev|holdout.
